content_zh:
ps：苟道，多女。
单女，纯爱读者，请直接划走。
……………
内华达州，拉斯维加斯拘留中心。
大厅内聚集着上百名囚犯，男女分区管理。
西北角落，一名二十出头、相貌俊朗的华裔男子被铐在长凳上。
旁边还坐着两位约莫二十岁的女孩，棕发白肤的叫瑞秋。
黑发小麦肤色的华裔叫丽莎。
她们是赌场的陪玩女郎。
两女五官精致，身材火辣，恰好符合林枫的审美，因此毫不吝啬地点了她们。
“林，这次你麻烦不小，可能会面临监禁。”
丽莎开口道，“在美利坚，限制他人人身自由是重罪。
看在你一向大方的份上，我出去后可以帮你请律师。
只要你付得起保释金，通常不会有事。”
林枫却神色平静：“保释金要二十万美金，我身上没这么多钱，还是等法官判决再说吧。”
他原本计划在拉斯维加斯玩两天就回国，没料到刚出赌场，就遭遇老黑抢劫，手机被抢。
“零元购”竟落到自己头上，这尼玛能忍？
林枫一脚将其踹倒，夺回了手机。
拿回东西后，林枫并未报警，在异国他乡报警太过麻烦。
出乎意料的是，这老黑反而先报了警。

警察到场后，客客气气地放了那个老黑，却将林枫逮捕，令他一时愕然。
警察顺便解释：“即使他抢了你的东西，你也不能阻止他逃离，更不可以追击或攻击他。”
结果，林枫因涉嫌袭击伤人、限制人身自由而被拘捕，保释金高达20万美金，这还不包括给老黑劫匪的和解费用。
显然，对方是看他是哗人才故意抬高价码。
至于丽莎和瑞秋，则是因年龄问题被一同带回。
拉斯维加斯规定，16岁可驾车，18岁可合法持枪，但须年满21岁方可饮酒、赌博。
两人均只有十九岁，因此被带来问话。
“林，这里是美利坚。”瑞秋也在旁补充道，“你涉嫌的罪名不轻。
估计刑期至少半年。
建议尽快找律师，花钱保释，否则后果很严重。”
“多谢提醒，但没钱也没办法。”林枫依旧淡然。
瑞秋和丽莎望着他这副无畏的模样，心中不禁觉得林枫此时反而透出几分魅力。
“林，现在不是逞强的时候。”
丽莎压低声音，“你在里面真的有可能被打死，出了事可没人管你，这不是在开玩笑”
“宝贝这是在担心我？”林枫不以为意。
“你要是真能安然无恙出来，我们乐意奉陪。”瑞秋挑眉道。
此时，一名女警拿着文件夹走进大厅，看见瑞秋和丽莎，露出无奈的表情：“瑞秋，又是你两，你是第几次进赌场了？”
瑞秋无所谓地笑笑：“第8次。”
“你呢，丽莎？”
“我才5次。”

“过来签字。”
“ok。”
离开前，瑞秋回头对林枫眨眨眼：“林，但愿你能活着出来。”

ps: Gou Dao, many women.
I'm a single woman, I just love readers, please check it out.
……………
Nevada, Las Vegas Detention Center.
There are hundreds of prisoners gathered in the hall, and men and women are managed separately.
In the northwest corner, a handsome Chinese man in his early twenties was handcuffed to a bench.
There were two girls around twenty years old sitting next to them. The one with brown hair and fair skin was named Rachel.
The Chinese with black hair and wheat complexion is called Lisa.
They are casino escorts.
The two women had exquisite facial features and hot bodies, which fit Lin Feng's taste perfectly, so he ordered them without hesitation.
"Lin, you are in big trouble this time and may face imprisonment."
Lisa said, "In the United States, restricting other people's personal freedom is a felony.
For the sake of your usual generosity, I can help you hire a lawyer when I get out.
As long as you can afford the bail, you'll usually be fine. "
Lin Feng looked calm: "The bail is 200,000 US dollars. I don't have that much money, so I'll wait for the judge's decision."
He originally planned to return home after spending two days in Las Vegas. Unexpectedly, he was robbed by a gangster and his cell phone was stolen as soon as he left the casino.
"Zero yuan purchase" actually fell on me, how can I bear it?
Lin Feng kicked him down and took back the phone.
After getting his things back, Lin Feng did not call the police. It was too troublesome to call the police in a foreign country.
Unexpectedly, the old black man called the police first.
When the police arrived, they politely let the old black man go, but arrested Lin Feng, which made him stunned for a moment.
The police explained in passing: "Even if he robs your things, you can't stop him from escaping, let alone chase or attack him."
As a result, Lin Feng was arrested on suspicion of assault, wounding, and restriction of personal freedom. The bail was as high as 200,000 US dollars, which did not include the settlement fee for the old black robber.
Obviously, the other party deliberately raised the price because he was showing off.
As for Lisa and Rachel, they were brought back together because of their age.
Las Vegas stipulates that 16-year-olds can drive and 18-year-olds can legally hold guns, but they must be 21 years old or older to drink or gamble.
Both men were only nineteen years old and were brought in for questioning.
"Lin, this is America." Rachel also added, "The crime you are suspected of is not light.
The estimated sentence is at least half a year.
It is recommended to find a lawyer as soon as possible and spend money on bail, otherwise the consequences will be serious. "
"Thanks for the reminder, but there's nothing we can do if we don't have money." Lin Feng remained indifferent.
Rachel and Lisa looked at his fearless appearance, and couldn't help but feel that Lin Feng was showing a bit of charm at this time.
"Lin, now is not the time to show off."
Lisa lowered her voice, "You really could be beaten to death in there. If something happens, no one will care about you. This is not a joke."
"Baby, are you worried about me?" Lin Feng didn't care.
"If you can really come out safe and sound, we will be happy to accompany you." Rachel raised her eyebrows.
At this time, a female police officer walked into the lobby with a folder. When she saw Rachel and Lisa, she showed a helpless expression: "Rachel, it's you two again. How many times have you entered the casino?"
Rachel smiled nonchalantly: "The eighth time."
"What about you, Lisa?"
"I only did it 5 times."
"Come here and sign."
"ok."
Before leaving, Rachel turned back and winked at Lin Feng: "Lin, I hope you can come out alive."
